content.text: {"narration":"Raw [[raw]]scores like 8, 2 and minus 4 are big, so [[sm1]]softmax puts nearly all weight on one key. [[scale]]Dividing by the square root of d k, here 64, shrinks them to 1, 0.25 and minus 0.5, so [[sm2]]softmax keeps a gentler spread.","objects":[{"kind":"text","id":"title","x":800,"y":110,"text":"Why scale the scores?","size":"m"},{"kind":"matrix","id":"m_raw","x":300,"y":300,"rows":[["8","2","-4"]],"label":"Raw scores"},{"kind":"matrix","id":"sm_raw","x":800,"y":300,"rows":[["0.997","0.003","0"]],"label":"Softmax of raw","hidden":true},{"kind":"arrow","id":"a_raw","from":{"id":"m_raw"},"to":{"id":"sm_raw"},"label":"softmax","hidden":true},{"kind":"matrix","id":"m_scaled","x":300,"y":560,"rows":[["1","0.25","-0.5"]],"label":"Scaled scores","hidden":true},{"kind":"latex","id":"f_scale","x":1200,"y":560,"tex":"\\frac{q\\cdot k}{\\sqrt{d_k}}","hidden":true},{"kind":"matrix","id":"sm_scaled","x":800,"y":560,"rows":[["0.59","0.28","0.13"]],"label":"Softmax of scaled","hidden":true},{"kind":"arrow","id":"a_scaled","from":{"id":"m_scaled"},"to":{"id":"sm_scaled"},"label":"softmax","hidden":true}],"actions":[{"do":"highlight","target":{"id":"m_raw"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"raw","color":"warn"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"a_raw"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"sm1"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"sm_raw"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"sm1"},{"do":"highlight","target":{"id":"sm_raw","row":0,"col":0},"durationMs":400,"cue":"sm1","color":"warn"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"m_scaled"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"scale"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"f_scale"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"scale"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"a_scaled"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"sm2"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"sm_scaled"},"durationMs":400,"cue":"sm2"}]}
